title: Inverse image preserves finite local constancy
statement: Let $b:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism and $A$ a finite commutative ring. Let $F$ be a module sheaf over the constant coefficient ring $A_Y$ on the small pro-etale site of $Y$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Suppose $F$ is locally constant as an $A_Y$-module sheaf [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] and has finite module stalks at every geometric point $y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$, with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]. Then the actual constant-coefficient module inverse image $b_A^*F$ is locally constant on $X$ and has finite module stalks at every geometric point of $X$.

proof.text: Apply the proved finiteLocal_iff helper in Sheaf.Paper.ProEtaleConstantModuleConstructibility (imported with import all). It identifies the intrinsic local constancy and finite geometric stalk conditions with fixed-coefficient finite constant models. This is precisely the local equivalence proved in steps 1--3 of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-module-constructibility], without choosing a stratification. Write the resulting pro-etale covering as g_i:W_i→Y, with finite model M_i and g_i^*G≅constant(M_i), where G is restriction to constant scalars.

Replace each W_i by P_i=W_i×_Y X. The projections q_i:P_i→X form a pro-etale covering by Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isPullback. Writing p_i:P_i→W_i, the equation q_i≫b=p_i≫g_i and the pullback compositors [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-comp] identify q_i^*b^*G with p_i^*g_i^*G. Apply p_i^* to the model isomorphism. Base change preserves the terminal site object, so Functor.constantSheafsheafPullbackIso identifies p_i^*constant(M_i) with constant(M_i); sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullbackIso compares the selected and constructed inverse images. Thus b^*G has finite constant models with the same finite M_i.

Use [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-module-pullback-encoding] to identify restriction to constant scalars of the actual intrinsic module pullback with b^*G. Finite local constancy of fixed-module sheaves is invariant under isomorphism. Apply finiteLocal_iff in the reverse direction to recover both intrinsic local constancy and finiteness of all specified geometric module stalks. The equivalence uses finite models and so avoids a new general inverse-image stalk formula. Empty schemes, empty covers and zero coefficients are already covered by that equivalence.

theorem proEtale_finiteLocalConstancy_pullback
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (b : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (F : proEtaleRingModules Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y A))
    (hF : IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf Y A F ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y),
        Finite (proEtaleGeometricModuleStalk y (proEtaleConstantRing Y A) F)) :
    IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf X A (proEtaleConstantModulePullback b A F) ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
        Finite (proEtaleGeometricModuleStalk x (proEtaleConstantRing X A)
          (proEtaleConstantModulePullback b A F))
